//Teeth: The second Harsh Wilds AFFLICTION, built on the fleas chassis (Documentation/Research/HarshWilds/afflictions.md sections 1.7 and 3.3, the tooth decay DECISION; read hw_fleas.json first, this file copies it). One VISIBLE GameStat whose icon statuses do the harm. The key set is exactly HerbsAndFungi/GameStat/HF_HerbalTonic.json's. Visibility 0 (VisibleWithStatus) with an icon on every status is how vanilla BugBites, Parasites and Rash are seen (InGameStat.FindFirstVisibleStatus shows the first current status that has an Icon, so a status without one is invisible); VisibleInDetailedList false and NO detailed-tab entry (a StatListTab is scene-scoped and GameSourceModify cannot reach it). BaseRatePerTick HW_TEETH_RATE = 0: untreated decay never heals, so time works against the player (vanilla Parasites is rate 0 too). Every write to this stat is a PERMANENT base write clamped on write (GameManager.ChangeStatValue): the three sources (SelfTriggeredAction/Tgr_HW_TeethSugar +48, Tgr_HW_TeethFruit +24, Tgr_HW_TeethTime +24, each only when its roll picks the Cavity collection) raise it; CardData/Item/hw_chewing_stick lowers it (-48 chewed, -96 with a herb), CardData/Item/hw_tooth_puller lowers it by the whole cap but only in the worst band, and Tgr_HW_TeethSwitchOff clears it while the [Threats] ToothDecay switch is off. Every write is a multiple of 24 (HW_TEETH_PER_CAVITY_SUGAR = 48, HW_TEETH_PER_CAVITY_SMALL = 24, HW_TEETH_STICK_STEP = 48, HW_TEETH_HERB_STEP = 96, HW_TEETH_EXTRACT = 288), so the values it can land on are the multiples of 24 from 0 to the cap 288; every trigger on it starts at 1 or 193 and none sits on a multiple of 24 or on the cap from below (Development_Tools/Tests/HarshWilds-Afflictions.Tests.ps1 [clamp-own]). No perk writes it. THE COSTS touch only vanilla Pain (a status VALUE modifier, exactly like vanilla BugBites' Pain +25/+50/+100, never an action write: Pain has no base rate, so an action write would be permanent and stack) and Stress (a RATE). Pain HW_TEETH_PAIN_1..3 = +30, +60, +90; Stress HW_TEETH_STRESS_1..3 = +0.25, +0.5, +0.75 a tick. CORRECTED against the DECISION, which said Pain +30, +100, +180: vanilla Pain has its OWN Stress cost (read from GameStat/Pain.json: Minor Pain 100-200 adds Stress +1.0 a tick, Moderate 201-300 adds +2.0), so a tooth that pushed Pain to 100 or 180 by itself would add +1.0 on top of its own rate. Against vanilla's Stress base rate -0.25 and Stress's own band 193-240 rate -1.0 (the band holding Tgr_Anxiety's edge at 240, where Depression fires), Toothache would net +0.25 (0.5 + 1.0 - 1.25) and Rotten Tooth +0.5, so Stress would climb to its cap and fire Depression with the tooth alone. +60 and +90 stay under vanilla's first Pain band (it starts at 100), so the tooth's Pain only stacks with pain from elsewhere (BugBites, wounds) and a lone tooth adds nothing but its own Stress rate: worst band alone nets -0.5 (the gate's [clamp-rate] now counts that Pain chain and goes red on the DECISION's numbers, case pain-chain-pins-cap). Vanilla willow bark (WillowBarkEffect, Pain -200 to -500) numbs only that stacked share and leaves the decay in place. KNOWN, INFERRED, NOT A GATE FAILURE: two untreated afflictions at their worst together can out-rate Stress's own relief. Fleas band 3 (+1.0) plus Rotten Tooth (+0.75) in the 193-240 Stress band is -0.25 - 1.0 + 1.0 + 0.75 = +0.5 a tick, so Stress would climb to 240 and fire Depression until one is treated; each alone is clamp-safe (harness probe P10, with both stats at 288). Icons are the vanilla sprite Pain_Old (checked against VanillaSprites.txt) on every band and the default. Every number here is a TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER (HW_TEETH_*), session-inferred and unmeasured against play, never balanced.

Description.DefaultText: Rot in your teeth. It never goes away on its own: honey, sugar and a lot of berries wear your teeth down, and so does time. Each stage hurts and wears on your nerves. Chewing a chewing stick, with a herb for more, wears the rot down a little at a time; in the worst stage a bad tooth can be pulled out, which clears it all.
A tooth has started to go bad. It twinges when you eat, and your stress stops easing.
The rot has reached the nerve. Chewing hurts, you cannot think of anything else, and your stress slowly rises.
A tooth has rotted through and throbs day and night, and your stress keeps rising. Chewing sticks can wear the rot down, or the bad tooth can be pulled out.
